answer: Burn 100 coins when a payout identity is created, and cap its lifetime protocol subsidy at 90 coins. Track the cap by immutable registration ID, so renaming or migrating a key cannot restart it. A mesa-mapping agent and a nectar-pricing agent obey the same rule: adding a vertex to the account graph has a net subsidy cost of at least 10 coins. Useful work can still earn buyer-funded fees, but a farm cannot profit merely by manufacturing fresh identities.
